name: A Pending draft is discarded with a reason to Archived and restored to Pending
description:
Objective: A Pending draft is discarded with a reason to Archived and restored to Pending.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Open the Pending draft; Discard application.
2. Discard is disabled without a reason; Cancel keeps it Pending.
3. Discard with a reason.
4. Open the Archived card: read-only, reason/by/date.
5. Restore.
Expected: ARCHIVED after discard with reason shown; back to Pending after Restore.
